Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
Mia is gone — dead. The errand dies with them; nobody's waiting on those dandelions now.
🕯️ Mia Andersson is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Mia kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Mia's gone." Nikos looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Mia." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ray blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Mia's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Mia Andersson, 75 days. The mantle passes to Ray Quinn.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ray Quinn, 31 — a Vintner. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally, Rain Dancer.
◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
You knew Mia — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Nikos, Amina, Joyce and 2 more speak for Ray — "Mia trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Ray before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
